summary: Graph ledgers retain transaction identity, payload-bound outcome journals, and request-token mappings; owner trees retain visibility sequences, routing epochs, entity reservations, and read leases; the facade retains a durable safe-vector mirror.
lifetime: Durable Object SQLite state survives actor eviction. Transaction outcomes and request-token mappings have bounded retention; active leases expire, and completed split metadata is retired after older snapshots no longer depend on it.
